checks.name: Profile set matches the declared inventory
Stage 1 CSV is well formed
checks.detail: Every data row carries a trailing delimiter, so each record has 19 fields against a 18-column header. A default pandas read_csv silently promotes field 0 to the index and shifts all signals one column left, mislabelling every signal and nulling Crss_F. Repaired in memory by dropping the surplus empty trailing field; the Stage 1 file is left unmodified.

checks.name: Repaired CSV matches the MAT sample for sample
checks.detail: 15904 samples compared across 17 numeric signals, joined on (profile, sample ordinal); max relative difference 4.943e-10 (column id_A). Confirms the in-memory repair is exact and the MAT is usable as the authoritative source.

checks.name: Missing-value inventory
checks.detail: ron_stage1_ohm: 8141. All are confined to ron_stage1_ohm, where Stage 1 itself writes NaN for ID <= 0.1 A. No other signal has gaps.

checks.name: Simulation time strictly increasing within each profile
Sampling interval uniform and equal to the solver step
checks.detail: median dt = 1.000000e-09 s, spread = 1.694e-21 s; solver declares 1e-09 s

checks.name: Summary JSON profile inventory matches the MAT
Summary JSON sample counts match the MAT
Stage 1 dataset defects propagated into Stage 2
checks.detail: Stage 1 recorded 4 dataset defects: ['curves_absent', 'qg_not_sum_of_parts', 'qgd_test_condition', 'thermal_absent']. These are dataset properties, not ingestion failures, and remain open in Stage 2.

checks.name: Evidence class recorded as unvalidated model output
checks.detail: Stage 1 label: 'MODEL PREDICTION - NOT VALIDATED'. No experimental validation data exists anywhere in the inputs, so no Stage 2 output may be described as measured or experimentally validated.

checks.name: Aging axis present in the source data
checks.detail: There is no aging time, no repeated measurement of the same device and no second device instance. t_s is simulation time within a single sweep. Permanent degradation cannot be separated from operating-condition changes.

physics_checks.name: Pcond is channel power (Vds*Ich) and carries a displacement residual
physics_checks.detail: Pcond is Vds*Ich with Stage 1's conduction-only channel current, while the exported ID additionally carries displacement and leakage current, so the two coincide only where nothing is moving: the median residual over dissipative samples is 6.674e-07 W. Largest gap over 705 saturated DC samples = 3.775e+01 W, at most 20.2 % of channel power. That gap implies a 3.106e+00 A displacement current, which exceeds the worst-case leakage (3.098e-05 A) by 100235x, so it is displacement charging and not a model error. The DC sweeps step Vds by 0.5 V per 1 ns sample, so these samples are not quasi-static and the residual is material here. On the switching load line the gap is far larger (up to ~843 W) because |dv/dt| reaches ~6e9 V/s. Downstream code must treat Pcond and Vds*ID as distinct quantities, must not add them together, and must not read the residual as a degradation signal.

physics_checks.name: Intrinsic capacitance positivity (Cds, Cgs >= 0)
physics_checks.detail: min Cds = 6.1625e-10 F, min Cgs = 1.0001e-09 F; 0 negative samples

physics_checks.name: Gate charge monotonicity during the charge sweep
physics_checks.detail: Qg starts at 4.7000e-09 C and ends at 1.6666e-08 C; 0 decreasing steps

physics_checks.name: Qg initial value at the start of the charge sweep
physics_checks.detail: Qg(0) = 4.7000e-09 C, not 0. Stage 1 defines Qg = Qgs + Qgd where Qgd includes the Cgd depletion charge at VDS = 75 V, which equals the printed QGD = 4.7 nC. Qg is therefore an absolute charge referenced to the drain bias; Phase 2B must use delta-Qg over a gate excursion, not Qg itself.

physics_checks.name: Exported RON interpretable as a conduction resistance
physics_checks.detail: 6144/15904 samples (38.6%) are both conducting and in the triode region. Stage 1 masks RON only on ID > 0.1 A, so the remainder report Vds/ID in saturation or in the off state, where the ratio is not a resistance. Phase 2B must use ron_valid, not the raw column.

physics_checks.name: Stage 1 RON agrees with recomputed Vds/ID where valid
physics_checks.detail: max relative difference = 0.000e+00 over 6144 gated samples

physics_checks.name: Temperature dependence present in the channel current
physics_checks.detail: Across the thermal sweep the 25->125 degC drain-current ratio deviates from 1.0 by at most 7.163e-08 (i.e. no dependence). The Stage 1 channel equation has no temperature term; only leakage scales. A temperature-normalised RON cannot be computed from this dataset without inventing a coefficient, so it is left unavailable.

physics_checks.name: Thermal model present (Tj rises above Tcase)
physics_checks.detail: max |Tj - Tcase| = 0.000e+00 degC. All thermal resistances and PTOT are TBD in the datasheet, so junction temperature is not modelled and no thermal stress indicator is available.

physics_checks.name: Samples outside absolute-maximum or continuous ratings
physics_checks.detail: 7330 samples exceed a printed rating, driven by the datasheet characterisation sweeps (peak |ID| = 2066.3 A against a 115 A continuous rating). Legitimate as measurement conditions, but they are not application operating points and must be excluded from stress indicators.

physics_checks.name: Aging / stress-history measurements present
physics_checks.detail: Every Stage 1 profile is a single operating-condition sweep on one simulated device at one point in time. There is no time-separated repetition, no stress history and no second device instance, so no permanent degradation can be separated from an operating change.
